protocol: Four preselected continuous 30-second windows. S1/S2 development; S4/S6 follow-up held-out subjects, not new people or an independent dataset. Freeze candidate before held-out scoring.
selection: Fixed before this recovery experiment. S1/S2 windows include previously observed development periods; S4/S6 windows do not overlap earlier scored windows. No frame-level action labels assumed.
reference: annot3 markerless multiview reference, body12; inference reads only RGB, calibration and timing.
